item.title: Interactive, in-browser cinematic volume rendering of medical images
item.description: This paper presents open-source cinematic volume rendering algorithms for medical images (CT and ultrasound) that run interactively in web browsers using standard GPUs, built on VTK and vtk.js with WebXR applications in mind. Check out this article!
